provenance.notes: Reconstructed from whoeasy test fixture whois.punktum.dk/via.dk.txt (Apache-2.0, commit a8347b8011, captured 2026-03-16) and the example in the official specification v6.3.1 (https://github.com/Punktum-dk/whois-service-specification): layout, banner and wording kept; the name, registrar, nameservers and dates are synthetic and contact data is removed. The session IP address is masked. Not captured by this project: outbound TCP port 43 was blocked on the development network on 2026-10-05. Registry terms of use and contact details are omitted for publication.
